about.label: About
about.heading: How I work
about.body: I build backend and distributed systems and carry the technical vision end to end — microservices, message queues, caching layers, observability. I care about the parts that don't demo well: idempotency, graceful degradation, dead-letter queues, the 3am pager that never goes off. I've also led: I grew the engineering team from 2 to 10, owned the technical direction, and worked directly with sales and clients — so I build with the business in view, not just the spec. But my center of gravity is the code. I work in Go and Node.js, and I'm comfortable across the stack when it earns its keep — React, Next.js, even Solidity and Electron. English C1, open to relocation and remote.
